summary: TODO-002 satisfies the approved acceptance criteria. SSE/in-memory pub-sub was removed, participant polling is implemented with hidden-tab pause/resume, admin pages use private Supabase Realtime with server-issued admin JWTs, and recorded validation covers realtime security, browser behavior, static validation, and relevant TODO-001 regressions.
warnings: I did not rerun validation commands because the workspace is read-only in this review session; I inspected the implementation and recorded evidence instead.
The /race manual static-token UI remains, but removing that path belongs to TODO-004 and is explicitly out of scope for TODO-002.
evidence: AC1: `src/app/api/events/route.ts`, `src/lib/realtime.ts`, and `src/lib/use-realtime.ts` are absent; `rg -n "EventSource|/api/events|publish\\(" src` returned no matches.
Participant polling is implemented in `src/app/race/page.tsx:11` and `src/app/race/page.tsx:59`: 10s polling, paused when hidden, immediate refetch when visible.

Admin Realtime hook is implemented in `src/lib/admin-realtime.ts:14`, `src/lib/admin-realtime.ts:44`, and `src/lib/admin-realtime.ts:89`: token caching, private `cp-admin:<sessionId>` channel, debounced refetch, subscription cleanup.
Admin screens use the new hook at `src/app/admin/sessions/[id]/ui.tsx:38` and `src/app/admin/sessions/[id]/ceremony/page.tsx:26`.
Admin token route checks `isAdmin()` before minting at `src/app/api/admin/realtime-token/route.ts:5`; JWT signing is server-only in `src/lib/realtime-jwt.ts:1`.

Realtime SQL migration sends only `{type, sessionId}` private broadcast signals from app-table triggers and adds an authenticated `cp_role=admin` receive policy at `supabase/migrations/20260927130000_admin_realtime.sql:5` and `:51`.

Recorded browser evidence reports 40/40 passed in `.ai/tasks/active/TASK-20260927-001/runtime/web/TODO-002/report.md`, including participant polling, hidden-tab pause/resume, admin live updates, ceremony updates, and cleanup/no duplicate subscriptions.

Recorded security evidence in `evidence/TODO-002/hosted/realtime-security-check.out.txt` shows anon/private joins denied, forged/expired/non-admin JWTs denied, anon public same-topic subscriber received 0 messages, and token route returned 401 without valid admin cookie.
Recorded static validation in `runtime/static/TODO-002/summary.txt` shows `VALIDATE_STATUS=PASSED`, lint baseline match, and `TSC_EXIT=0`.
Recorded bundle scan in `evidence/TODO-002/bundle-scan.txt` shows 0 hits for service-role key and JWT secret in `.next` / `.next/static`.
regressions_checked: TODO-001 anon table/RPC access regression evidence inspected in `evidence/TODO-002/hosted/anon-check.out.txt`: app tables and RPCs remained unreadable/unexecutable with anon key.
TODO-001 API regression evidence referenced by implementation: hosted parity/concurrency/cascade checks passed with 0 failures.

UI regression coverage inspected in browser report: participant join, team creation/join, valid tag, out-of-order error, duplicate tag error, finish, admin live view, announcement toast, and ceremony update flows passed.
